body:
PROBLEM (verified 2026-08-14): `adlc ticket create --write` (and body-editing `update` without `--authorize`) performed under `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS=1` mutates the sharded ticket store and records NOTHING to the gate-manifest. Only rail-narrowing via `adlc ticket update --authorize` appends a signed entry. The `/adlc:adlc-ticket` skill text tells operators that editing the ticket set while rails are frozen is 'a deliberate, audited action' — the audited half is currently untrue for creates and plain updates. Concretely: the 9 seam tickets on PR #493 were created under bypass and left no manifest trail, which a cross-model review then correctly flagged as an unauditable provenance gap.

BUILD

1. In the canonical ticket-store service (the code path behind `adlc ticket create/update/complete --write`), when the mutation is performed with `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS` set (i.e. the store is a frozen trust root and the write is a bypass), append one gate-manifest entry per mutation via @adlc/gate-manifest's record API: gate `ticket-mutation`, data at minimum { op, ticketId, storeHashBefore, storeHashAfter, bypass: true }.
2. Key semantics follow the #370 precedent: with ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY present the entry is signed; with no key the mutation REFUSES (fails closed, store untouched) unless the operator passes an explicit opt-out flag mirroring `--allow-unsigned`, in which case the entry is written unsigned and a warning names the consequence.
3. Do not record when the store is NOT a frozen trust root (no ticket declares rails yet) — pre-bootstrap repos keep zero-ceremony authoring.
4. Align the `/adlc:adlc-ticket` skill text and docs/tools mirror with the implemented behavior.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

- AC1: with rails frozen and a key present, `create --write` appends exactly one signed `ticket-mutation` entry whose storeHashAfter matches `ticket store status --json`. Verify: a new test in the ticket-store service's test directory, named in the build, run via node --test.
- AC2: with rails frozen and NO key, `create --write` refuses before writing the store (store hash unchanged) unless the explicit opt-out flag is passed. Verify: same test file.
- AC3: with no rails declared anywhere, `create --write` records nothing and succeeds as today. Verify: same test file.
- AC4: `update` and `complete` mutations under bypass record entries the same way; `update --authorize` keeps its existing rail-narrowing entry (no double-record for one mutation). Verify: same test file.
- AC5: suite green: npm test.

NOTES FOR THE BUILDER

- Re-verify the premise against the current service code before building (the store service moved to segmented manifest.d writing in #482; record through the same forest-aware writer prosecute/record-cross-model uses so entries land in the active segment).
- This ticket declares NO rails: introduce build-time rails in-session via the PreToolUse hook flow, per the 2026-08-14 lesson that railed tickets merged ahead of their builds wedge the build PR in CI.
title: Record a signed manifest audit entry for every bypassed ticket-store mutation
